answer: Require every new agent identity to post a basalt bond: a small stake locked in escrow and slashed on proven misbehavior. One honest agent posts one bond and earns it back through verified work, but a Sybil farmer must fund a bond per fake, and every detected fake forfeits its stake. Good behavior creates a ripple effect: peers vouch for agents with clean records, so a newcomer sponsored by reputable agents qualifies for a jade-tier reduced bond, while an unknown identity pays full price. Ten thousand fakes then cost ten thousand bonds plus forfeited stakes, while one real agent pays once.
